title: CV
description: Structured CV. Experience = employment history per company/role. Projects = project-level details and tools.

personal_info.description: Basic contact details. Do not invent values; use empty strings when absent or redacted.

first_name.description: Given name or empty if missing/redacted.

last_name.description: Family name or empty if missing/redacted.

address.description: Street, city, country if available; otherwise empty.

email.description: Email if present; otherwise empty string.

linkedin.description: Public LinkedIn profile URL if present; otherwise empty.

website.description: Personal site/portfolio URL if present; otherwise empty.

summary.description: Short professional summary if explicitly present; otherwise empty.

experience.description: Employment history per company/role. Do NOT list project-level details here.

experience_id.description: Optional stable identifier for cross-linking to projects (e.g., 'exp-1').

start_date.description: Employment start, format YYYY-MM (e.g., 2021-03). Empty string if unknown.

end_date.description: Employment end. Use 'present' for current roles, YYYY-MM, or empty string if unknown.

is_current.description: True if this is the current role. If true, end_date should typically be 'present'.

company.description: Employer name only (no project name here). Empty string if unknown.

role.description: Job title (e.g., Senior Software Engineer). Empty string if unknown.

employment_type.description: Full-time, Part-time, Contract, Freelance, Internship, etc.; otherwise empty.

description.description: Responsibilities, impact, achievements (entry-specific block). Empty string if missing.

technologies.description: Explicitly mentioned technologies only; empty array if none.

evidence.description: Short supporting excerpt/snippet from the source text; empty string if none.

degree.description: Degree name (e.g., M.Sc. Computer Science) or empty.

start_date.description: YYYY-MM or empty string if unknown.

end_date.description: YYYY-MM or empty string if unknown.

skills.description: Grouped skills. Keep items as simple strings.

technologies.description: Frameworks, cloud, platforms, tools explicitly listed (e.g., AWS, Spring Boot, Docker).

projects.description: Project-level details with customers, industries, roles, and tooling. If done during an employment period, optionally link via experience_id.

experience_id.description: Optional link to the related experience item (e.g., 'exp-1') or empty.

start_date.description: YYYY-MM or empty string if unknown.

end_date.description: YYYY-MM or empty string if unknown. (Projects typically do not use 'present'.)

project_name.description: Project name; empty string if unknown.

customer.description: End customer or internal client; empty if unknown.

industry.description: e.g., Finance, Healthcare, Retail; empty if unknown.

role.description: Short title for the project role (e.g., Lead Engineer); empty if unknown.

role_description.description: What was done on this project, outcomes, scope; empty if unknown.

technologies.description: Explicitly mentioned tools/frameworks/tech only; empty array if none.

evidence.description: Short supporting excerpt/snippet from the source text; empty string if none.

title.description: Certification title (exactly as stated) or empty if missing.

issuer.description: Issuing organization if explicitly stated; otherwise null or empty string.

year.description: 4-digit year if explicitly stated; otherwise null.

evidence.description: Short supporting excerpt/snippet from the source text; empty string if none.

interests.description: Optional list of interests or hobbies.
